hint: graphPlan.axisScale:{x,y} (piecewise-polynomial and multi-curve) gives each axis its own scale for a graph whose axes measure different things (minutes against kilometres): x and y are positive integers, decimals or fraction strings, and only their proportion counts ({x:1,y:12} draws one y unit twelve times as long as one x unit; the proportion stays within 1:64 and 64:1). It replaces the automatic squeeze, so axisSqueeze must not be set (AXIS_SCALE_WITH_SQUEEZE). Other families refuse it (AXIS_SCALE_UNSUPPORTED_FAMILY). Write the real tick values in axisTickValues and the axis names in axisTitles. The observer recomputes y/x itself: AXIS_SCALE_RATIO_MISMATCH means the recorded axisRatio differs from it, EQUAL_UNIT_SCALE_MISMATCH that the drawn figure does not follow it.
